headline: Boilers fixed,
not replaced.
copy.sub: Boiler repairs, new boilers, servicing and gas safety certificates around Heathrow, Slough and West London. Rated 4.9 by 73 customers on Google.
copy.about_alt: Sandeep testing a gas supply on a bank of meters
copy.lede: Sandeep has been fixing boilers that other engineers, British Gas included, said needed replacing. Customers call him back year after year for their service because he finds the real fault, explains it, and charges fairly.

services.title: Boiler repairs
services.blurb: Breakdowns, no heating or hot water, pressure loss and error codes. Fixed, not replaced, where it can be.
services.intro: Most boilers don't need replacing. We find the real fault first.
includes: Parts fitted on the day where possible
Honest advice on repair or replace

services.title: Boiler installation
services.blurb: New combi and system boilers, sized for your home, with neat copper pipework and a magnetic filter.
services.intro: A tidy install with the pipework done properly, as you can see in our photos.

services.title: Servicing and maintenance
services.blurb: A yearly service keeps your boiler safe, efficient and its warranty valid.
services.intro: A full service with a written record, done in about an hour.

services.title: Gas safety certificates
services.blurb: CP12 landlord certificates, gas meter work and tightness testing for homes and businesses.
services.intro: Landlord gas safety certificates done quickly, with the paperwork sent the same day.

services.title: Hot water cylinders
services.blurb: Unvented and vented cylinders fitted, serviced and repaired.
services.intro: From a faulty valve to a brand new unvented cylinder.

services.title: Central and underfloor heating
services.blurb: Radiators, manifolds, pumps, valves and controls for wet heating systems.
services.intro: Cold spots, noisy pumps or a new underfloor manifold, sorted.

steps.title: Find the real fault
steps.text: We test before we touch anything, so you only pay for what's actually wrong.

steps.title: Test it safely
steps.text: Gas supply and pressure checked at the meter, every time.

steps.title: Fit it properly
steps.text: Clean copper, clipped and labelled. Work you'd be happy to open the cupboard to.

steps.title: Flue and finish
steps.text: Flues fitted and sealed outside, and everything checked before we leave.

steps.title: Heating back on
steps.text: Boiler commissioned, controls set up and the paperwork sent over.

faqs: Can you repair my boiler instead of replacing it?
Usually, yes. We find the actual fault first, and only suggest a new boiler when a repair really isn't worth it.
Do you do landlord gas safety certificates?
Yes, CP12 certificates for houses, flats and commercial premises.
How quickly can you come out?
We take call-outs around the clock. Ring and we'll tell you when we can get to you.
Do you work on unvented cylinders?
Yes, installs, annual checks and repairs.
Heathrow, Slough, Colnbrook, Langley, West Drayton, Hayes, Hounslow, Staines and Windsor.
